svg.title: Home lab network wiring and VLANs

text.tspan: Every physical cable in the lab. Each host has one network port, so it runs as a trunk: the switch carries all six lab VLANs to both
hosts, and OPNsense on pve01 routes between them.
afw-hub · OPNsense, gateway for all VLANs
UPS USB plugs in here (NUT server)
Gaming stays on the host OS. Lab VMs
run only when it isn't gaming.
LAB VLANS · PROXMOX SDN ZONE zone-lab ON vmbr1
Every VLAN's gateway is afw-hub on pve01. Spokes reach each other only through the hub firewall (default deny), the same way Azure spokes route through Azure Firewall in the
hub. The lab uses 10.10.0.0/16 to 10.40.0.0/16 so it never overlaps the Azure address space.
